ICS 59.080.70; 65.020.20TXD 35New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard provides requirements of nonwoven jute agrotextiles (JAT) for growth of plants and suppression of weeds.NOTE - Selection of jute agrotextile shall be decided principally on topography of the site, gradient of slope, annual rainfall, nature of soil, type of weeds and plants.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
